page.layout: One page of text, with two marginal notes in the left margin ("969.", "963.") and a black-letter note beside the first lines ("Der Meüse-thurn."). Below the text, the catchword "FLORUM" at the right.

main_text.p: 969.consumserunt. Pari modo HATTO quoque Mogun-tinus Archiepiscopus, & WILDEROLPHUS Argenti-nensium Antistes, 963.à muribus miserabiliter corrosi & devorati leguntur: cum hic D.Stephani aedem, ejectis Vestalibus, cremasset: ille vero fame ingruente, egentium multitudinem in horrea quaedam vocatam, utpote quae ibi alimoniam & frumenta acceptura esset, admotis ignibus combussisset: à quo eventu turris, quae adhuc cernitur in Rheni fluminis medio prope Bin-Der Meüse-thurn.gam, quo & ipse spe salutis se receperat, nomen obti-nuit. Nec enim est locus, quo suam divina potestas pro-hibeatur exercere vindictam.

Haec & similia tragici exitus tyrannorum exempla intuentes Reges & Principes, affectuum suorum impotentiam comprimant: omnibusque modis efficiant, ut subditi metuant non ipsos, sed pro ipsis: satiusque & jucundius ducant, diligi quàm metui: quod & tutiorem vitam, & voluptatem effi-cit pleniorem.

page.notes: The printed letters "f" standing for long s (e.g. "confumferunt", "Haec & fimilia") were transcribed as s. Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed. The black-letter marginal note reads "Der Meüse-thurn." as printed, with the umlaut shown as "e" in the scan. The marginal numbers 969 and 963 are printed as shown.
